title: Magnetic Shelf for Washing Machine and Fridge – Storage Without Drilling
descriptionHtml:
The detergent sits on the floor behind the door

The laundry room has zero shelves and the landlord has opinions about drill holes. So the bottles sit on top of the machine and fall off with every spin cycle.

The shelf that sticks to the metal

A shelf with a magnetic back that attaches directly to the side of the washing machine or fridge. 29.5 cm wide with a rim that keeps the bottles in place – up in seconds, moved just as fast, leaves no holes.

Features

  • Up in seconds, no holes – the magnet attaches straight to the metal
  • The bottles stay put – the rim holds them when the machine spins
  • Move it whenever you like – take it off, attach it to the next metal surface
  • 29.5 cm wide – detergent, fabric softener and stain remover in a row

Change of mind

You have 14 days to change your mind, counted from the day you receive the item.
